rollback_review.reason_installation_is_blocked: LOOK v23 accepts only 0c90a161 and 28fe66b4; it does not accept ff390318. A later successor gate is required before rollback.

look_stage2_contract.legacy_field_name_note: The runner deployment gate still names its fields look_v22_stage2/look_v22_receipt/look_v22_receipt_sha256. This is accepted only as legacy naming: those fields must bind the real v23 receipt above, its SHA and successor job, not a v22 artifact.

residual_gates: LOOK v23 candidate must independently pass and a real held-first successor must publish the exact stage2 receipt before 28fe66b4 installation.
The sole policy publisher must install 28fe66b4 under the shared account lock only after fresh policy, ownership, capacity and unresolved-intent checks.
The exact source claim must then be reserved and the production asset published; neither exists at review time.
A fresh ownership overlay, pinned wrappers, runtime contract, deployment gate and final binding must be generated and independently validated.
Only after those gates may one held-first GPU request be created and released after its zero-GPU afterany finalizer is durably identified.
Rollback ff390318 remains a separate later transaction requiring a new LOOK successor stage2.
